Your first report was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in this channel: the gate kiosks at Vantorre's Hartford plant were offline, both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, and the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard.

Between that report and kiosk 1 coming back at 11:03, the channel only records the guard writing trailer numbers by hand. At 11:03 Mateo Quiroga posted that the guard had checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. Nothing else in the channel describes the guard's activity in that window.
